summary: Pin the synthetic legacy-batch rank dependency of message candidates.

replay.detail: Test-only arithmetic fixture. No admission, replay, checkpoint proof, live trim or candidate source is changed.

schema.detail: Only a disposable test connection creates synthetic tables. No production schema, trigger, migration or readiness certificate is installed.

rules.detail: Uses the existing canonical claim-key helper without changing claim validation, authority, selection or retention.

compatibility.detail: No route, CLI, transport or public field changes. Fixed raw parent candidates do not imply fixed canonical rank.

downtime.detail: No production opening or background maintenance changes.

manual.detail: No setup or repair action is added. The fixture is not evidence of a supported legacy admission or reopen seam.

recovery.detail: No persisted state changes. Thread lifetime, readiness, canonical selected-parent maintenance and writer/read costs remain unqualified.
